h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Barasat

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Barasat

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Barasat

c: Barasat, the headquarters of North 24 Parganas, gets heavy rain every monsoon, and low-lying grounds in the district can hold water for days. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Barasat for schools, colleges, municipal parks, government campuses and housing complexes. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,660 km away, and deliver them by road.

Surface is the part of an open gym that buyers most often overlook. Machines placed on bare soil end up standing in mud for weeks, and the area around each station wears into a hollow that holds water. A concrete base with a slight slope solves most of this. Rubber flooring around the machines gives better footing and dries quickly after rain, and we supply it along with the equipment. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts then handle the humidity of the Bengal plains without rusting.

richText.heading: Getting the base right before the rains

c: Plan the base first, then the machines. A raised concrete pad or strip, sloped to one side, keeps water away from footings. For the machines themselves, the

are popular choices, since each serves two people on one base. We tell you whether each machine needs grouting or can stand on its own base. Finish the base work before the monsoon arrives so installation can go ahead without delay.

items.q: What surface should go under outdoor gym machines in Barasat?
items.a: A raised concrete base with a drainage slope, with rubber flooring around the machines if possible. Rubber gives better grip and dries faster than soil after heavy rain.
Yes. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment. Share the size of the area and we will include it in the layout and quote.

items.q: Can the machines stand on soil?
items.a: We do not recommend it in a high-rainfall area. Grouting each post in concrete, or a self-standing base on a concrete pad, keeps the machines firm and level.
